title_zh: 场景—空间—运营闸门合同
boundary: Thresholds below are review triggers for a future approved window. They are not measured local performance, statutory limits or permission to operate.

rows.trigger_condition: baseline audit opens a bounded review
rows.pass_condition: accessible route continuity = 1.0 in the approved audit sample
rows.evidence_required: count sheet, route audit and public status record
rows.action_if_fail: hold window and keep human patrol

rows.pass_condition: serious conflicts = 0 and every injected stop reaches human takeover
rows.evidence_required: event log, physical stop and takeover receipt
rows.action_if_fail: stop test and return to manual delivery

rows.trigger_condition: heat or crowd warning is issued
rows.pass_condition: no blocking accessibility event remains unresolved at closure
rows.evidence_required: obstruction log, accessibility review and closure record

rows.pass_condition: lit human return and staffed contact are continuously available
rows.evidence_required: lighting walk, staffed roster and return-route check

rows.trigger_condition: rain/snow or heat alert reaches the review threshold
rows.pass_condition: weather fallback is rehearsed and the ordinary route remains open
rows.evidence_required: weather trigger, route state and rollback receipt
rows.action_if_fail: freeze automation and publish human route

rows.trigger_condition: a booked curb window is requested
rows.pass_condition: booking never occupies the continuous public/fire route
rows.evidence_required: time-window board, clearance check and complaint channel
rows.action_if_fail: withdraw booking and restore human-only curb

rows.pass_condition: pedestrian, accessibility, emergency and service paths remain legible
rows.evidence_required: route plan, stewards and public notice
rows.action_if_fail: hold automated service and keep manual stewards

rows.trigger_condition: network loss is injected or observed
rows.pass_condition: safe stop, broadcast, human takeover and recovery are all recorded
rows.action_if_fail: remain human-only until two clear rounds

rows.trigger_condition: child or older-adult assisted journey is requested
rows.pass_condition: guardian/participant confirmation and staffed equivalent path are available
rows.evidence_required: consent state, staffed handover and no-app route
rows.action_if_fail: decline automation and provide human service

rows.pass_condition: inspection does not block access and no personal image stream is retained
rows.evidence_required: asset ID, route clearance and data deletion receipt

rows.pass_condition: methods, limits, responsible roles and failed cases are publicly legible
rows.evidence_required: rights-cleared method note and public review log

rows.trigger_condition: resident complaint or opt-out is received
rows.pass_condition: human response is available and correction/closure is published without identity exposure
rows.evidence_required: complaint receipt, response clock and anonymised closure

rows.trigger_condition: maintenance or charging interface is opened
rows.pass_condition: tools, fire access and public route remain separated
rows.action_if_fail: close interface and use manual staging

rows.pass_condition: all affected reviewer classes complete a route/stop review
rows.evidence_required: four-class review, errata update and public summary
rows.action_if_fail: do not open the next seasonal window
